user_query: What are the two-semester academic warning and 1.75 CGPA dismissal conditions?

retrieved_chunks.text:
## 1. Academic Standing and Warning
1.1 An undergraduate student whose cumulative grade point average (CGPA) falls below 2.00 at the end of any regular semester is placed on Academic Warning.

1.2 Under the Fall 2026 revision, a student who remains on Academic Warning for two consecutive regular semesters and has a CGPA below 1.75 is dropped from the degree programme.

## 2. Penalties for Unfair Means
2.1 Any student found using unfair means during a mid-term or final examination shall have the paper cancelled and be referred to the Unfair Means Committee, which may award an F grade in the course or suspend enrollment for one semester.

## 2. Incomplete (I) Grades
2.1 A temporary Incomplete (I) grade may be awarded only when a student misses the final examination due to an approved emergency.

2.2 If an Incomplete grade is not resolved within the first two weeks of the following regular semester, it automatically converts to an F grade.
